decision: Use seven fixed logic cells with three independent family replicates each
Cross conditional LD and heteroskedasticity in four null cells using paired seed indices
Count shared families rather than candidate tests or resamples as independent replicates
Retain pure amplification as direction-negative and obvious rotation as positive control
Treat three-replicate summaries as smoke diagnostics rather than FWER or power estimates
Require subject-disjoint selection and inference samples and apply the selected target
Bounded-smoke PASS authorizes only a prospective GC-screen rc2 protocol draft
Apply minimum fitted relative rank gap 0.10 to observed and every bootstrap statistic
Set an observed ineligible candidate statistic to zero and candidate p-value to one
Retain ineligible candidates in the four-candidate family and multiplicity dimension
Do not retune the 0.10 threshold using smoke or later p-values
R1.5 PASS and this design package do not authorize running bounded smoke without new approval
